planets.name: WASP-71 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Mpingo with a 2.9-day year, found in 2012.

text.card: WASP-71 b was found in 2012 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Mpingo. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
